cause_quote: The tab refactor removed `if (props.inspectionError) { return renderRetryError(props.inspectionError, props.onRetryInspection); }` from `renderAccess`, leaving `if (!props.inspection)` to render the loading skeleton even after failure.
user_saw: After a plugin inspection failed, the Permissions section kept showing a loading skeleton alongside the error and Try again.
summary: The plugin settings UI now shows the Permissions skeleton only while inspection is pending and suppresses the empty-state message until permission data is known.
reasoning: I checked the parent of #142713 and confirmed that the existing Access and Capabilities section returned the retry error before checking whether inspection data was missing. That commit moved the error to a shared notice and made the access renderer show a skeleton whenever inspection data was absent. The grouped settings editor, #150235, and the Solid migration preserved that behavior.
